traceCompleteness.decision25Counterfactual: recorded per cell, not applied: max(allowanceMinimum, floor(allowanceShare x successful requests)) and whether the incomplete count exceeds it
traceCompleteness.rule: one whole-measurement window (every cell is a no-fault cell). Complete = the request's own trace id observed and exactly the route's services. A successful request without a complete trace is telemetry loss: counted and recorded, never blocking. trace-completeness.json records per window the successful, complete and incomplete requests (unsuccessful separately); for every incomplete request its scheduled offset, whether its own trace id was observed and which required path services were missing; the count of incomplete requests per missing service; and the contiguous runs of consecutively scheduled requests that are each successful and incomplete (first and last scheduled offset, request count, missing services), so a lost export batch shows as one run. Evaluated on the target before the next cell and replayed byte for byte by the terminal
